description: Exploratory binary Iris QML classifier replicated over stratified splits, two ansatze, two depths and two initializations.
dataset: scikit-learn bundled Iris dataset; class 0 versus class 1 only; no download
feature_map: standardize using training split only, then angle=pi*tanh(z/2); for 8 qubits repeat the four encoded features twice
notes: Binary target is Iris class 1 versus class 0.
Each split is stratified; standardization statistics are fitted on its training split only. Split 461 is the v2 split.
ring applies a CX ring after every trainable RY layer, so cones saturate; brickwork applies one alternating nearest-neighbour CX sublayer per layer, so cones stay local.
The quantum model outputs X and Z expectations on every wire; a classical affine head supplies the logit.
Every trainable RY occurrence receives an independent parameter and exact two-term parameter shift.
This exploratory small-data screen does not establish general QML training performance.
